That night he climbed the spiral stairs, lit the great beam, and let it sweep the water a little longer, hoping someone, somewhere, was still watching for home.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一个尚未醒来的巨人，静静呼吸。街灯把空荡的马路染成淡黄，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，留下一声轻响。便利店的灯依旧亮着，收银员打着哈欠。环卫工人推着车，扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。高楼的窗户大多漆黑，只有零星几扇透出微光，那是失眠者或早起者的身影。天边泛起一丝灰蓝，鸟儿还没有鸣叫。这一刻的城市属于寂静，也属于那些守望黎明的人，温柔而孤独。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a big problem by solving a smaller version of the same problem.\n- It keeps calling itself on smaller pieces until the piece is tiny and easy to answer directly.\n- Think of nesting dolls: you open each one until you reach the smallest doll that doesn't open."}
